name: 雛菜
text:
なんだ～
やっぱり告白じゃなかったのか～！
trans:
Boo～
It wasn't a confession after all～!

name: 雛菜
text: なんかつまんないね～
trans: That's no fun～

name: 小糸
text: ひ、雛菜ちゃん……！
trans: H-Hinana-chan...!

name: 雛菜
text:
小糸ちゃんが慌てて走ってくるから
期待しちゃったよ
trans:
Koito-chan came running, flustered and all, so I
was expecting something.

name: 雛菜
text: ね、透先輩もでしょ～？
trans: Weren't you, too? Toru-senpai～

name: 透
text: え？
trans: Eh?

name: 小糸
text: だ、だって……！
trans: I-I mean...!

name: 小糸
text:
ああいうところ
実際に見たことなかったし……
trans:
I've never seen a confession before, much less one
at such a place, so...

name: 小糸
text: そうなのかなって、思っちゃって……！
trans: I assumed that that might have been one...!

name: 雛菜
trans: Heh～?

name: 小糸
text:
でも考えてみればそうだよね……
結構人いるところだったし
trans:
I suppose it couldn't have been one, now that I think
about it... It's quite a crowded place, for one.

name: 小糸
text:
告白ならもっと
人のいないところで、する……のかな？
trans:
People do confessions at more secluded places...
I suppose?

name: 小糸
text:
中庭とか……
体育館裏とか……？
trans:
Places like the courtyard...
Or behind the gymnasium...?

name: 透
text: えー
trans: Ehー

name: 透
text:
詳しい
小糸ちゃん
trans:
Koito-chan's.
Super knowledgable.

name: 小糸
text: く、詳しくはないんだけど……！
trans: N-Not at all...!

name: 小糸
text:
この前事務所に置いてあった漫画
パラパラっと見てみたら
trans:
I just happened to see it while flicking through a 
manga lying around the office the other day.

name: 小糸
text: そんな感じのやつだったから……
trans: It was that sort of manga, so...

name: 雛菜
text:
ん～、でも
今時わざわざ呼び出して告白する～？
trans:
Hmm～ Then again, would people usually ask
someone out to be confessed to these days～?

name: 小糸
text:
ぴぇ……！
し、しないの……！？
trans:
Pyeh...!
T-They don't...!?

name: 雛菜
text:
なんか、
チェインとかじゃない～？
trans: Well, wouldn't they just use Chain or something～?

name: 雛菜
text: わかんないけど～
trans: Don't know if people do, though～

name: 透
text: あー
trans: Ahー

name: 小糸
text: そ、そうなんだ……！
trans: I-I see what you mean...!

name: 小糸
text:
でも、直接のほうが
気持ちが伝わりそうだよね……？
trans:
But wouldn't it be better to convey those feelings
in person......?

name: 小糸
text: 緊張はするだろうけど……
trans: That'll probably make them super nervous, though...

name: 雛菜
text:
あ～……
両想いだったらいいかもね～
trans:
Ah～...　Maybe it'd be easier if both parties have
feelings for each other～

name: 小糸
text:
あ……
そ、そっか……
trans:
Ah...
I-I see...

name: 小糸
text:
振られちゃう場合も
あるんだもんね……
trans: It's possible to get rejected too, huh...

name: 雛菜
text:
うん～
振られるほうも嫌かもだけど
trans:
Yeah～
Some might not like rejecting others too.

name: 雛菜
text: 振るほうもやだしね～？
trans: It feels bad to reject others' feelings, right～?

name: 雛菜
text: 知らないけど～……
trans: I don't know how about that, though～......

name: 円香
text: ……盛り上がってるけど
trans: ...You guys sure are pumped up.

name: 円香
text:
委員会の連絡事項
伝えに来てただけだから
trans:
Looks like the student council had a message and
he came only to deliver it.

name: 雛菜
text:
へ～？
そうなの～？
trans:
Heh～?
Is that so～?

name: 雛菜
text:
じゃあほんとに
大したことないやつだったんだ～……
trans: So it really wasn't a big deal, then～...

name: 円香
text:
勝手に覗いて
勝手にがっかりしないでくれる？
trans:
Can you not peep at others, then get secretly
disappointed by yourself?

name: 雛菜
text:
それなら雛菜、お昼ごはんを
優先すればよかった～
trans:
Well, if that's all it was about then Hinana should
have prioritized lunch～

name: 小糸
text: ひ、雛菜ちゃん……！
trans: H-Hinana-chan...!

name: 雛菜
text:
今度から覗く時は
透先輩みたいにパン持って行こ～……
trans:
Next time I peep, I'd bring along a bun or
something like Toru-senpai～...

name: 透
text: ふふっ
trans: Fufu.

name: 透
text: いいね
trans: Sounds good.

name: 雛菜
text: あは～
trans: Aha～

name: 雛菜
text:
メロンパンもいいけど～
あんぱんと牛乳のほうが本格的だよね～？
trans:
Melon bread's nice and all, but～
Red bean bread and milk makes it feel more like
those police dramas, right～?

name: 雛菜
text: 張り込みみたいで！
trans: It'll be like a proper stakeout!

name: 透
text:
呼んでよ
浅サン、とか
trans:
Ah, call me like the dramas then.
Asa-san, or something.

name: 雛菜
text: じゃあ雛菜は雛サンかな～
trans: Then, Hinana can become Hina-san, maybe～

name: 小糸
text: ふたりとも……！
trans: Be more serious, the two of you...!

name: 小糸
text:
も、もう覗くのとか
やめようよ……！
trans: L-Let's stop peeking at others already...!

name: 雛菜
text:
え～、小糸ちゃん
いちばんしっかり覗いてたのに～？
trans:
Eh～, but wasn't Koito-chan the one who's most
engrossed peaking～?

name: 小糸
text: う……そ、それは……！
trans: N......No way, that's just...!

name: 小糸
text: ご、ごめんね円香ちゃん……
trans: I-I'm sorry, Madoka-chan...
